issue.title: (( task wikilink picker for Bob Mac Capture
issue.description: Typing `((` anywhere free text is allowed in a Bob Mac Capture draft opens a large, fuzzy, keyboard-first picker over every task in the vault. Choosing a task replaces the `((` token with a valid Obsidian block link such as `[[foo#^bar]]`. A task without a block ID is named first through a prompt prefilled with a good suggested ID. bob-cli owns the trigger grammar, the candidates, the link text, and the ID write; the app only presents them.

payload.entry: FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE: Reviewed every note on e7.1 through e7.4. e7.1 #2 and e7.2 #2 are one semantic proposal (seven CLI themes/types assertions), already causally owned by active bob-cli-e6 note #1. Declined new task and de corroboration because the former duplicates active epic work and the latter has a distinct root cause. No other PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP entries. The missing Mac compilation/render review and newly found wikilink defects are e7 work, not external follow-ups.

LAND AUDIT (remaining work, 2026-10-30): Read epic, all four children and every note, approved plan, CLI commits 30e093ac/53bf3dfa and Mac 031f100/8f303e2 with source. Confirmed history=all and link_form=shortest in discovery/grouping and shared formatter; URL-skipping suggestion path is wired for every caller. Since first epic commit, reviewed CLI 8d7309ff, fe56228f, 2631a1c9, 66ddba93, c0f94390, 41338bcf and Mac d41bb61; type storage/defaults use shared scanners, plain wikilinks feed e8 mention scanning without new grammar, and trailing @@ plus template gating need coexistence regressions. Remaining e7 defects: Mac run https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/40975062017 at 8f303e2 passes lint/build but test compile fails in CaptureWikilinkTaskPanelTests.swift:29,46,63,80 (Swift argument ordering); analogous out-of-order arguments exist in new design fixtures, and no PNG review occurred. The Mac discards Bob picker descriptor/query in picker/chip state and reconstructs marker/removal/caret ranges; closed-token chip query includes closing parentheses. Multiword full-snapshot refetch requires equal end ranges, but Bob intentionally returns a shorter range at the opener: direct-source field-function harness on Follow up ((foo bar returns (10,19) at cursor18 versus (10,15) at cursor12, so chip reopening fails and auto-open keeps a partial filtered pool. The same harness returns None for Follow up ((foo and [existing](url) at cursor15: punctuation after the caret incorrectly suppresses completion. Required UI polish is unfinished (hidden row dimming/grouped Done capsules, Add ID label, colored detail link; shared headers can show Not in a Pomodoro). Plan a medium tale for only these fixes, actual macOS compilation/tests and 20-image visual review, integration regressions, then this epic closeout in the coder turn. Mac SSH timed out; CI remains available. epic-symbols currently empty; neither repo has symvision recipe. Epic has no parent_bead. Do not close or mark plan done until repairs and gates succeed.

IMPLEMENTATION: Root cause was that bob capture-parse omitted (( task spans while Bob Mac Capture opens completion only from Bob-returned spans. bob-cli now uses one shared token scanner for completion and parse spans, reports delimiter/query/delimiter spans, fills gaps around existing spans, and stops unclosed query ranges at punctuation. Mac Capture gates completion and delimiter paint from those spans, with generated parse fixtures including older Bob output. Landing tale step 1 unclosed punctuation boundary fix and step 3 candidate initializer argument ordering fix are included. Keep wikilink_task_spans and completion_field_at on the shared scanner; token boundary edits should retain the char-boundary invariant test. Do not close this epic or mark either plan done.
